page.title: Job detail
page.purpose: Inspect one durable operation with its exact shot snapshot, execution receipts, partial artifacts and safe recovery options.

priorities.statement: Understand what is executing and what has finished.
See limits, receipts and useful partial work.
Recover or retry only after reconciliation.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Record submitted snapshot and queued reason without claiming rendering started.
Display observed completed frames/steps and actual limits.
Keep stop request and actual worker terminal evidence distinct.
Retain partials, event history and backend/provider reconciliation.
Show recovery plan and idempotency basis; no duplicate submit while uncertain.
Show cap/funding/enforcement blocker and supported local actions.
Output can be available while settlement remains explicitly pending.

claims.statement: Recovery reconciles authoritative job and payment state before new work begins, preserving receipts and partial outputs.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: Execution success, complete output validation and operator final-look acceptance remain separately visible.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

x-design.layout: State and observed progress above preview/filmstrip; tabs for parameters, event log, artifacts, worker, privacy and accounting with sanitized diagnostics.
controls: Inspect frozen recipe/source versions and launch authority
Preview retained completed frames and logs without implying final success
Request stop and inspect downstream effects
Reconcile provider/worker status and settlement before retry
Open result, save diagnostics or resume supported frame ranges
details: A terminal process plus file existence is insufficient: frame coverage, dimensions, decode, color tags, source clocks and representative review remain separate checks.
Missing cost/final settlement is pending/unknown, never zero by inference.
Retry explains reused versus new operation identity and asks for fresh authority only where the operation actually needs it.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.
